articles.headline: NFL Week 11: Big takeaways, questions and fantasy spin from Sunday's games
articles.description: Our NFL Nation reporters react to all the action, answering the biggest questions coming out of each Sunday game. Here's what we learned from Week 11.

articles.headline: Jeffery Simmons matches career high with 3 sacks in Bears' win
articles.description: Jeffery Simmons recorded three sacks in the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday, which tied his single-game career high.

articles.headline: Jets score on first 5 drives and edge Chargers 27-24 to snap 5-game skid
articles.description: — Geno Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns, including two to Sterling Shepard, and the New York Jets scored on their first five drives to beat the Los Angeles Chargers 27-24 on Sunday and end a five-game skid.

articles.headline: Eagles' Riq Woolen benched after missed tackles vs. Steelers
articles.description: Eagles cornerback Riq Woolen was benched in favor of veteran Jonathan Jones late in the first half of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.

articles.headline: 'Locked into the moment,' Bryce Young rallies first-place Panthers past Ravens
articles.description: In a back-and-forth game laced with lead changes, Bryce Young rallied the Panthers to a 35-33 home win over the Baltimore Ravens on Sunday at Bank of America Stadium, a second straight victory for the 5-5 Panthers that padded lead in the NFC South.

articles.headline: Jesse Minter: I take responsibility for latest Ravens loss
articles.description: Ravens coach Jesse Minter took accountability after Baltimore's 35-33 setback to the Panthers extended the NFL's longest active losing streak to six games.
